audit_meta.actual_stack: Next.js 16.3.2 + React 19.2.8 + Tailwind 3.4 (not 14.2.5 as in the prompt)

conflicting_areas.issue: Dual token systems: @layer tokens (--color-*) vs Shadcn HSL (--background/--primary). Marketing uses both; ds-root remaps Tailwind utilities.
Two @layer components blocks; leftover .font-editorial Cormorant fallback vs --font-family-display Fraunces.
Overlays compete: NewsletterPopup (z-newsletter), VisibilityIntake (210), dialogs (220-240), header (80). Letter can cover intake.
Rate limits in-memory (AUDIT-003). Middleware no longer imports Node security.ts (Edge-safe) but API routes still process-local.
Dual contact: Tally primary + email fallback; Book a Demo is Link /contact not calendar.

duplicate_files.suggestion: Old draft key logon-visibility-draft-v1 unused vs logon.intake.draft.v1. Delete or re-export from visibility/.
Footer uses site-footer; logon-footer classes mostly unused.

button_audit.notes: Plain Link /contact, md+ only; not Button-asChild.
React data-expanded; CSS fold <1024; min-h-11 links.
Opens intake; dialog now fixed 92dvh with overflow-y auto on .left.

form_audit.notes: Primary; webhook /api/webhooks/tally; email fallback in details.
Named export; barrel @/components; SafeIsland in layout; color-scheme light.
localStorage draft; visibilityProfileAction; no Apps Script secret in client; completeness weighted.
Dialog + server action getSolutionRecommendationAction + rate limit.

api_audit.notes: assertActionRateLimit; Resend optional; webhook HMAC header if set.
Edge-safe CSP nonce via Web Crypto; in-memory API rate map.

routing_audit.route_structure: App Router under src/app. Marketing chrome via ChromeShell except SYSTEMS set verda/verdara/vista/tessera/chamfer.
routing_audit.nested_routes: /insights/{cluster}/{slug} must redirect to /insights/{slug}; catalogue concat in src/lib/data/insights.ts.
routing_audit.client_server_sync: sitemap from site-index + insights. /visibility in menu + SERVICE_PAGES. Insights hub still use client (AUD-UI-014).

data_fetching_audit.fetching_methods: Mostly static TS modules (insights, menu-data, site-index). Server actions for forms/AI. No SWR/React Query.
data_fetching_audit.caching_strategy: Next fetch cache unused for marketing; Insights static. Rate limits not Redis.
data_fetching_audit.performance_optimization: dynamic() for BotWidget, BookDemo, BackToTop. Images next/image except some SVG img.

state_management_audit.state_strategy: Zustand use-ui-store (mobile menu). React context ChatbotProvider + VisibilityProvider. next-themes storageKey logon-theme.
state_management_audit.context_usage: VisibilityProvider wraps ChromeShell children. Newsletter not in ChromeShell.

coding_standards.eslint_adherence: next/core-web-vitals; no-restricted-imports relative + newsletter barrel + chamfer. eslint key removed from next.config.mjs historically.
coding_standards.style_guide_adherence: Named exports preferred; tokens in globals; marketing hex still in tailwind showcase palettes.

accessibility_audit.aria_labels: Skip link, mega aria-current, footer aria-expanded, intake dialog, newsletter dialog.
accessibility_audit.semantic_html: Single main#main-content in ChromeShell. Header banner. Footer accordion buttons.
accessibility_audit.keyboard_navigation: Escape closes overlays; focus-visible rings; ThemeToggle onSelect. Intake tab order follows DOM.

performance_audit.code_splitting: dynamic ssr:false widgets; newsletter action dynamic import on submit.
performance_audit.resource_optimization: Remote Picsum blocked historically; local marks. WebsiteLoader must stay unimported.

navigation_audit.nav_consistency: menu-data.ts drives header mega, footer columns, mobile accordion. Newsroom /about/newsroom. Visibility under Resources.
navigation_audit.active_states: pathname + aria-current; nav-pill cream invert on navy.
navigation_audit.mobile_nav: Sheet right, md breakpoint aligned with desktop nav and Book a Demo.

header_footer_audit.header_consistency: Vista navy bar h-16 all marketing pages. Standalone systems skip Header.
header_footer_audit.footer_consistency: site-footer tokens; fold <lg; no fake status line.
header_footer_audit.global_components: ChromeShell is the only chrome mount.

responsiveness_audit.breakpoint_consistency: xs 480 documented; nav md 768; footer lg 1024; intake split 1024. See docs/RESPONSIVE_AUDIT.md.
responsiveness_audit.touch_targets: min-h-11 / --touch-min 44px on header, footer, intake, letter.

current_issue_fix.reported_error: The `bg-text-dim` class does not exist @ globals.css:341
current_issue_fix.explanation: bg-text-dim is not in tailwind.config.ts. LOG_ON equivalent is --color-ink-muted or hsl(var(--muted-foreground)). Never @apply a class that is not a Tailwind utility or a @layer component.

additional_critical_fixes.note: copyToClipboard never throws in e2b iframe.
Dialog height min(92dvh,92vh); .left overflow-y auto min-height 0.
Web Crypto nonce; middleware does not import shutdown.ts.

structural_improvements: P0 keep tokens: paper --background 48 100% 98.4%; accent #BD005B; no Cormorant.
Delete src/lib/visibility-profile.ts or re-export from src/lib/visibility.
Split globals.css (>2300 lines) into tokens.css + chrome.css + logon-experience.css.
Keep five Magic Patterns routes standalone.
technical_improvements: Phase 2 visibility: Apps Script webhook without client secrets (text/plain POST).
npm audit remaining vulns; next-themes peer React 18 vs React 19 --legacy-peer-deps.
best_practice_adoption: Proof figures only LOG_ON delivery records.

global_considerations.cross_platform_compatibility: Preview requires 0.0.0.0:9002; clipboard policy differs in iframes; dvh for iOS.
global_considerations.internationalization_support: English only; locale en-NG metadata; no i18n framework.
global_considerations.scalability: Static Insights catalogue scales; in-memory rate limit and newsletter cooldown do not.
global_considerations.deployment_strategies: Netlify logonai.netlify.app; Tally webhook that host; secrets in Netlify env.
